description: Wraps one page of SteamSpy's paginated 'all' bulk endpoint.
signature: def fetch_all_page(self, page: int) -> tuple[int, dict]
docstring:
Fetch one page of the SteamSpy bulk catalog.

Args:
    page: Zero-based page index, per SteamSpy's request=all&page=N convention.

Returns:
    (status_code, payload) as returned by HttpClient.get_json. payload, on success, is a dict keyed by appid-as-string, each value containing SteamSpy's per-app summary fields (name, developer, publisher, positive, negative, owners, price, initialprice, discount, tags, ...).

Note:
    Does not call RateLimiter.acquire() internally in this docstring's described contract -- fetch_steamspy_catalog (the module-level orchestrating function) calls acquire() once per page before invoking this method, per AcquisitionConfig.steamspy_page_delay_seconds.
postconditions: Returns the tuple as-is from HttpClient.get_json; performs no additional parsing or validation of the page contents

edge_cases.input: page beyond the last real page of the catalog
edge_cases.expected_behavior: SteamSpy returns an empty dict {} with status 200; fetch_all_page returns (200, {}) unchanged -- pagination-stop logic lives in fetch_steamspy_catalog, not here

edge_cases.input: SteamSpy is rate-limiting this client and returns 429
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returned as (429, ...) unchanged; caller reacts via RateLimiter.observe_response
